bull.b: Loop's core technology targets chemical recycling to produce virgin-quality PET from waste. That structural capability addresses rising brand/regulatory demand for circular content and creates a differentiated feedstock solution versus mechanical recycling, offering durable competitive advantage if scaled and commercialized.

A multi-year, fixed-price/take-or-pay contract with a major brand materially improves revenue predictability and creditability for project financiers. Such anchored demand reduces commercialization risk for initial facilities and supports syndication of project debt when replicated across additional customers and geographies.

bull.t: Near-term engineering revenue and non-dilutive support
bull.b: Immediate, high-margin engineering and licensing revenues can fund corporate overhead and advance permitting without equity dilution. Combined with non-dilutive government support, this provides a durable bridge to project financings and helps extend runway while larger plant builds progress toward commercial cash generation.

bear.t: Severe operating losses and cash burn
bear.b: Sustained, deep losses and multi-year cash burn have eroded equity and materially weaken financial flexibility. Negative equity complicates standard leverage metrics, increases reliance on external funding, and makes execution of multi-year capital projects contingent on timely access to new capital or profitable near-term revenue streams.

Project finance depends on reaching volume pre-sales thresholds. Reliance on LOIs and difficulty obtaining long-term brand commitments raise execution risk: failure to secure contracted offtakes delays debt syndication, increases equity dilution risk, and can push back construction timelines and expected cash generation.

Dual Nasdaq compliance notices introduce strategic distraction and potential delisting risk over months. If unresolved, listing transfer or delisting would impair liquidity, raise cost of capital, and constrain access to public financing—materially limiting the company's ability to raise equity or securitize assets for project builds.
